title: Overdue reminders wired through the existing composition root
task: Add overdue reminders to billing: `Reminders.Send() error` finds unpaid invoices whose due date has passed and sends one message per invoice, `Invoice <id> for <customer> is overdue`, through a mailer we do not have yet (SMTP arrives next sprint). Wire it into `app.New` the same way `Invoices` is wired: construction stays in the root and Reminders receives what it needs ready to use.
